title: Initiative Order Advantage by Player Count
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:initiative player_count_band=* encounter_outcome_score=*
| stats avg(encounter_outcome_score) as avg_encounter_outcome_score, count as events by player_count_band
| sort - avg_encounter_outcome_score
description: Shows average encounter outcome score by player-count band for initiative-order outcomes.
value: Average encounter outcome score by player-count band helps compare initiative-order outcomes across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `encounter_outcome_score` on `rpg:initiative` events and normalize `player_count_band` so Splunk can summarize performance by player-count band.
visualization: Bar chart of average encounter outcome score by player-count band.
grandmaExplanation: It frames the average encounter outcome score for each player-count band so you can see what works best for initiative-order outcomes.
